name: agent_fem_bc
description: Agent-declared boundary conditions — the prompt embeds a service load case; the fem stage declares none and falls back to the generated spec's cases (use_parent_fallbacks). The fem_loadcases gate re-checks the RESOLVED resultants/centroids against the physics the prompt described, not the agent's wording. No verify_spec gate: the case measures BC declaration, not spec conformance (the local model mislabels 'flange' as 'boss' — real finding, wrong signal for this case).

stages.prompt:
Steel cantilever test bar with mounting flange, parametric.

Frame: bottom face of the flange on the XY plane (z = 0), overall part centred in X (x = -60..+60) and Y (y = -20..+20). Overall bounding box: 120 (X) x 40 (Y) x 40 (Z) mm.
- Square mounting flange at the -X end: 20 thick along X (x = -60..-40) x 40 wide along Y (y = -20..+20) x 40 tall along Z (z = 0..40).
- Rectangular cantilever bar emerging from the flange's +X face at mid-height: 100 long along X (x = -40..+60) x 20 wide along Y (y = -10..+10) x 10 tall along Z (z = 15..25). Union into one solid.

Service loads for structural design (declare in spec.load_cases): the flange's outer -X face at x = -60 (region kind='face', axis='-x') is bolted flat to a wall (fully fixed). A 200 N downward shear force (force_n = [0, 0, -200]) acts on the bar's free +X tip end face at x = +60 (region kind='face', axis='+x').
